title: Pictogram morph
description: A unit-icon chart (each person, house or dot stands for a number of units) that pops in icon by icon and then morphs between layouts, every icon flying to its new slot with a sequenced ease-out: one grid coloured by group, clusters per group, an icon bar chart, everything collapsed into one block, or hold (all but a few icons of the focus group dissolve, along with the backdrop, so the footage under the block shows through around the icons that stay). For "1 in 4" stats, share-of-whole explainers and data stories.

groups.description: "Label=value" per group, in order; the first group (or focus) takes the accent.

unit.description: How much one icon stands for (values are divided by it and rounded); at most 400 icons in all.

layouts.description: The layouts in order, each morphing into the next: grid, groups (a cluster per group), bars (icon columns on a baseline), collapse (one tight block) and hold (keep `keep` icons of the focus group in place, dissolve the rest and the backdrop).

captions.description: Headline per layout (missing or empty: none for that layout).

focus.description: The group in the accent (0-based); the others step down in tone.

keep.description: Icons of the focus group that stay through a hold.

backdrop.description: Draw the palette's paper behind the chart (a hold dissolves it); false: icons only, over whatever is below.

suffix.description: After group values, e.g. % or k.
